heroHeadline: Suspected Russian Drone Recovered Off Polish Coast as Romania Logs Two More Border Incidents
heroSubtitle: Polish forces recovered a suspected Russian military drone from the Baltic Sea near Rusinowo, close to Jarosławiec, on September 14 — though officials stopped short of calling it a confirmed airspace violation. It followed a busy week for Romania: five separate drone-debris finds washed up along the Black Sea coast on September 11, including an explosive fragment destroyed at Vadu beach, alongside a Snake Island radar scramble, and a drone that crossed Ukraine and Moldova crashed in a Suceava County cornfield near Botoșenița Mare on September 12. Separately, German media reported on September 12 that investigators had identified a Russian GRU-linked suspect and a Belarusian accomplice behind the August Leipzig/Halle Airport drone plot, reinforcing Berlin's Russia attribution, while a NATO jet scrambled over Vilnius on September 13 turned out to be a false alarm — a flock of birds.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
